notes.title: iBasket Manager 3 now available on Steam
notes.content:
[b]The brand new iBasket Manager 3 is now a reality[/b] and is available today on Steam for free. To start your career as a basketball manager you will only need an internet connection and an email address.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061170/iBasket_Manager_3__Online_Basketball_Manager/

After the success achieved with the International Basketball Manager saga, [b]obtaining more than 85% of very positive reviews on Steam[/b], UPLAY Basketball wanted to bet on a free-to-play online product in which each manager will fight to reach the top of worldwide basketball.

Each user will have to choose a plot of land in the place of their choice in the world and, from there, they will have to start building the basic foundations for the whole organization to function correctly. The construction of buildings and equipment, having a pavilion at the height of your team and surrounding yourself with the best possible staff to manage the different areas of the club, will be one of the first decisions that each manager will have to make.

[b]Join the iBasket Manager 3 Discord[/b] to share your achievements and suggestions and, in this way, contribute to the growth of this community of basketball lovers.
